appearance.summary: White American male with red hair and blue eyes.

character.name: Frozen In Flames
character.name_note: The name is the union of the family's two lines: Frozen, his father's line, and Flames, his mother's, with 'In' between them, given to the first child of the joining to mark it. In daily life the character is usually called Frozen.
character.occupation_frame: Musician and recording engineer; founder of a small recording studio.
character.status: Living. No death year is recorded: the character's story is open, by design, so the same character can take later surveys in other genres.

corrections.changes: Birth year 1960 -> 2000; birthplace Memphis -> Dallas, Texas; mother Evelyn Flames -> Ruby Flames; father Harold Flames -> Onyx Frozen (the family name splits: the mother's line is Flames, the father's line is Frozen, and the character's name is their union); partner Alice Flames -> Amber Flames, under the family naming law that every family member's first name is a crystal or gem; appearance recorded (white American male, red hair, blue eyes). The shipped biography book (v0.2.0) retains the earlier invented values; a corrected edition is queued separately.
corrections.source: Set by the author; supersedes the biography build's invented record values.

defining_events.event: Born in Dallas, Texas, the first child of Ruby Flames and Onyx Frozen; given the joined name of the two family lines.
Began paid work after school in his father's repair shop, rewiring radios and restringing guitars.
First recording session work, as an unpaid assistant in a Dallas studio, paid in tape and lessons.
Founded his own small recording studio, the Cold Room, in a converted icehouse in Dallas.
Married Amber Verano, a photographer he met when she was hired to shoot a session.
A fire destroyed the first Cold Room; he rebuilt it over two years rather than close.

fact_notes.father_name: Onyx Frozen; repairs radios and guitars in a small Dallas shop.
fact_notes.mother_name: Ruby Flames; piano teacher and church organist.
fact_notes.partner_name: Amber Flames, born Amber Verano; a photographer.

family.branches: The Chicago branch descends from Topaz Frozen. Jade Frozen's household is in Fort Worth. The Verano family joined by the respondent's marriage in 2023.
family.family_saying: A family keeps what it can fix, and fixes what it keeps. In the family's telling the saying is Jasper Frozen's; each generation restates it against its own circumstances.
family.flames_line: Garnet Flames (1920-1994), born in Holly Springs, Mississippi, a keeper of furnaces and boilers -- the work the family telling gives as the name's origin -- who came to Dallas in 1949. His wife Jet (1923-2001), born Jet Callahan, is the line's matriarch: she began the family Bible in 1949 and entered its births, marriages, and deaths for fifty-two years. Their son Slate Flames (1946-2016), born in Holly Springs, worked in heating and refrigeration in Dallas and is the line's patriarch; he married Opal Reyes (born 1948), a piano teacher and church organist, through whom the line's music descends. Their children: Ruby Flames (born 1975) and Jet Flames (born 1979). Slate's brother Zircon Flames (born 1950) has been estranged from the family since a quarrel over Garnet's estate in 1994.
family.frozen_line: Flint Frozen (1918-1992), born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, a millwright and machinist who came to Dallas in 1947 after wartime service and stayed. His wife Pearl (1921-1999), born Pearl Kowalski, kept the line's papers and accounts. Their son Jasper Frozen (1948-2018), born in Dallas, was a toolmaker and the line's patriarch: the doctrine the joined family still quotes -- a family keeps what it can fix, and fixes what it keeps -- is his sentence. Jasper married Coral Boudreaux (born 1950). Their children: Onyx Frozen (born 1973) and Jade Frozen (born 1976). Jasper's sister Topaz Frozen (born 1951) left Dallas for Chicago in 1969; her son is Jasper Whitfield.
heirlooms: The family Bible of the Flames line, its flyleaf carrying births, marriages, and deaths in Jet Flames's hand from 1949 forward, continued by later hands.
Flint Frozen's toolbox, the one he carried into Dallas in 1947.
The Frozen line's day books and the respondent's session logs: the family's written record of its work.
Ruby Flames's piano, unsold through every hard year.

family.naming_tradition: Every child of both lines is given a first name from the crystals and gems. The two lines kept the custom independently before they joined -- the Flames line in Mississippi and Texas, the Frozen line in Pennsylvania and Texas -- and the joined family keeps it still. The single exception is the respondent himself: the first child of the joining was given the two lines' surnames as his name, Frozen In Flames, to mark the union.
family.the_joining: Ruby Flames and Onyx Frozen met in Dallas in 1998 over a broken piano pedal at a church social -- she was playing; he was the repairman the church called -- and married in 1999. Their children: Frozen In Flames (born 2000), given the joined name, and Opal Flames (born 2003), named for her grandmother Opal.

open_by_design: No death year and no closing chapter facts: later genre packs need room to keep asking this character questions.
Geography after Dallas is deliberately loose (years of session work and travel) so later packs are not contradicted.
The catalogue of the character's recordings is described by kind, not enumerated, so later packs can specify it.
provenance: Fabricated demonstration material. Frozen In Flames is a fictional persona created for this project; the life recorded here was invented as test data and describes no real person. The character's core facts (birth year and place, parentage, the two family lines, the naming law, appearance) were set by the author on 2026-11-24 and supersede the values the biography build invented; see corrections.
purpose: Canonical demonstration character record for the survey-to-book proof-of-works series. Frozen In Flames is the series' demonstration user: the demo answers for every genre pack are this character's answers, drawn from this single invented life, so the same character headlines every proof book.
